intro: Your stats, your log, your clan. All as cards.

fullExtra: Leave the player name blank on any command to use your linked RSN.
One code covers every account you play: main, iron, alts.
`/unlink` removes an account. Staff can force-unlink a name that is not yours.
short: Link yourself once and every command knows your name.
1. Run `/connect` and the bot sends you a code.
2. Paste the code into the Oath Forsaken plugin in RuneLite.
3. Play. Any account you play on links itself to you.
The code is not a password and cannot touch your RuneScape account. We never ask for a Jagex login anywhere. Anything that does is a scam.
topics.title: Setup

fullExtra: `/profile [player]` - Website profile card.
`/pb [boss] [player]` - Personal bests synced by the plugin.
`/tfa [player]` - The Fractured Archive KC and collection log card.
`/leaderboard` - Collection log leaderboard.
Stats come from Wise Old Man and RuneProfile. PBs come from the Oath Forsaken plugin. Gains are recorded daily.
short: Your stats as pictures. Text commands and slash commands both work.
`!kc zulrah` - Boss kills, and the boss's collection log strip on the same card.
`!clog` - Your whole log, or one page of it.
`!skills` - Levels, XP, total level, combat.
`!dry zulrah` - What you are dry on, what came early, the luck on each drop.
`!gains` - XP and KC from the last 7 or 30 days.
Shortcuts: typing a boss name alone shows its KC card (`!toa`). `!log` is `!clog`, `!lvl` is `!skills`. Boss names can be typed plainly: `!kc nightmare` works.
topics.title: Cards

fullExtra: Bosses are grouped Raids, Bosses, Skilling bosses, Slayer bosses. Raids pick as one entry (ToA, CoX, ToB) with the kill split on the card.
PvM opens on the totals: total KC, bosses led, raid KC, top bosses.
Clogs picks a tab first, then a page, for head-to-head collection logs.
Your other saved RSNs sit on the card as one-tap swaps.

images.caption: The Overall view: totals side by side.
A boss head to head: kill counts, both collection logs, and the luck on each drop.

short: Two players, one card. `/compare` or `!compare RSN1 vs RSN2`. One name compares them against you.
The buttons on your card switch views: Overall, Skills, PvM, Clogs. Pick a boss or a skill to go deeper.
Only the player who ran the compare can press its buttons.
Full version: https://oathforsaken.cc/compare
topics.title: Compare

fullExtra: First verified hunter takes the lane title: Reaper of Chaos for PvM, Artisan of Chaos for Skilling. The title holds until the next winner takes it.
Every winner goes on the website: https://oathforsaken.cc/bounties
Want a ping when a new contract posts? Take the Bounty Hunter role in #roles.

images.caption: A contract poster. Press Submit Proof under it to open your proof thread.

short: Contracts hang in #bounty-board, two at a time: one PvM, one Skilling. No sign-up.
1. Get the drop while it's live.
2. Screenshot it.
3. Press **Submit Proof** on the poster and post it in the thread.
The drop has to land after the contract posted. Drops from before it do not count. Staff cross-check every proof and make the final call.
topics.title: Bounties

fullExtra: Get your code with `/connect`. One code per Discord account covers every RSN you play.
Drop sharing is its own toggle, off by default. Turn it on and your drops can back up bounty proof.
Counters only sync for collection log pages you open in game.
short: The plugin links your accounts to the bot and sends it your PBs and collection log counters.
Sharing is off until you turn it on in the plugin settings. It never types, clicks, or plays for you.
topics.title: Plugin

fullExtra: **Gains are empty.** Gains build from daily snapshots, so a new link needs a day or two before numbers show.
**A clog page will not come up.** Use the page's in-game name, like `!clog hard clues`. Boss and raid pages show on the KC card instead.
short: **The card shows no name, or the wrong name.** Run `/connect`, check the code went into the plugin, then play a session so the account links.
**A number is missing.** That account may not be synced yet. Play with the plugin on and try again later.
**A drop did not count for a bounty.** Check the contract posted before the drop landed. If it did, ask staff in your proof thread.
topics.title: Fixes
